decision.rule: exactly one repeated + measured + causally-attributed + avoidable cliff (directive §11/§18); the generator flags candidates mechanically; a cliff is named ONLY via explicit --name-cliff AND the full nine-criterion gate must be satisfied (PART C)

A_generate_routing_subphase.note: top-3 generate() subphases by mean wall, each present on >= 2 independent problems; an avoidable action is NOT pre-identified — naming requires the coder to state the counterfactual Z

C_gauntlet_boundary.gauntlet_evidence: POST_RANK_GAUNTLET on 2/10 rows; failure wall 35.134 s; classes ['MODEL_FAILURE', 'RATE_LIMITED']
C_gauntlet_boundary.note: the R525 purpose boundary must hold; a repeated gauntlet failure under the intact boundary is a Maior observation for the B_post_rank_subphase class, never a license to broaden retirement

E_other_stages.note: stages are never named from maximum latency alone (Final R526 rule); recorded in section A of the ranking

criteria.name: wall is a measured value from a durable artifact
criteria.typed_reason: gen_spans/PHASE_SPAN/stage_log measurements; no estimated values in the ranking input

criteria.name: wall attributed to a named, typed sub-operation
criteria.evidence_reference: H subphase means + I top-level phase walls + B2 source job walls
criteria.typed_reason: every ranked value carries a typed sub-operation / phase / source-job reference; UNKNOWN remainders are never ranked

criteria.name: typed, named avoidable action
criteria.typed_reason: set to TRUE only when exactly one cliff is named with a typed intervention; successful necessary work is never marked avoidable

criteria.name: exactly one named intervention, no standing-prohibition violation
criteria.typed_reason: checked against the R526 standing prohibitions (no global Zai retirement, no linear ATTACK change, no ordinary independent_attack change, no stage-order / prompt / budget / retrieval / gate change, no speculative parallelization; R525 gauntlet purpose boundary intact)

criteria.name: no standing prohibition violated
criteria.typed_reason: machine-checkable subset of the standing prohibitions; resolved when the named intervention is verified against the list

criteria.name: current-arm quality baseline recorded for after-arm parity check
criteria.typed_reason: span_verbatim_rate 1.0 + funnel OBSERVED_IN_STAGE on all current rows is the parity baseline; the after arm must match it

criteria.name: production_deployment tuple with live-verified values
criteria.evidence_reference: production_deployment (target/deployed SHA, health GREEN, drift GREEN)
criteria.typed_reason: Art. LXXI delivery standard; verified live at record write time

criteria.name: exactly one cliff named; no second intervention
criteria.typed_reason: TRUE only when exactly one --name-cliff is supplied and it matches a flagged candidate; --name-cliff / --intervention identify an already-authorized cliff, they do not manufacture authorization

nine_criterion_gate.rule: exactly one intervention authorized ONLY when every criterion is TRUE; any FALSE / UNKNOWN / missing criterion fails the gate closed
nine_criterion_gate.note: the regression-suite failure set on the instrumented build is byte-identical to the pristine HEAD set (5 pre-existing failures, none introduced by the R526 S2 instrumentation repair); disclosed, not repaired in this round

classification_not: NOT claimed: any end-to-end speedup (no intervention ran)
NOT claimed: unattributed SYNTHESIZE remainder is waste (it is UNATTRIBUTED by rule)
NOT claimed: successful post-rank provider wall is waste

quality_baseline.note: quality recorded; parity applies only if an intervention runs

round_states.note: these five states are distinct and never collapsed: measurement_complete is always TRUE once the current-arm harvest + ranking + reconciliation are durable; the other four are FALSE on the measurement-only close and are updated by _after_close only when a named intervention actually ran, was measured on the after arm, and was deployed

remaining_blind_spots: SYNTHESIZE spans absent on uninstrumented/failed rows -> UNATTRIBUTED by rule
per-attempt provider-call split inside generate() is not durably recorded (R523 budget note stands)
